mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.20, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings prospects and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 900 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, strong retail sales (RSAFS) reflect sustained consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS exceeds 400,000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weak economy with accommodative policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.20 and UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates low inflation, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 235, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900 (HOUST) indicate weak consumer demand for housing, reducing construction activity and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below 900, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
